summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery data locals in autopilot install manager

delivery.outcome: Rename the generic local variable 'data' to stage-accurate names in each of the six functions of src/koru/autopilot/install_manager.py that mutate it: pyproject (_source_version and _is_koru_source_root, the parsed pyproject.toml TOML table), direct_url (_installed_editable_source_root, the parsed direct_url.json editable-install metadata), package_manifest (_expected_plugin_version and _expected_plugin_build_sha, the parsed plugins/<dir>/package.json document), report_dict (format_install_manager_report, the InstallManagerReport.to_dict() serialization; the 'data' parameter of _install_manager_base_lines that receives it is renamed to report_dict as well). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'data' group drops from 6 scopes to 0. Each new name lands at <= 2 scopes, so no (file, variable) group grows toward the threshold. Pure rename of function-internal locals and one private helper parameter; no signature, return shape or behavior change; no other file touched.
nonGoals: No behavior, parsing, validation or interface change
No restructuring into a shared document-decoding abstraction (each function already owns one decode stage; the shared generic name was the defect, not a missing abstraction)
No rename of locals in other files that happen to use 'data' (each is an independent local in its own file scope)
No fix for pre-existing shotgun findings in other files - minimal scope for this ticket's reported smell only

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local renames only, inside one module. Every function that decodes a document names the decoded payload after the parse stage it serves (pyproject TOML table, direct_url editable-install metadata, package_manifest plugin manifest, report_dict serialized report); the generic name 'data' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports a 'data' mutation group of exactly 6 scopes - _source_version, _is_koru_source_root, _installed_editable_source_root, _expected_plugin_version, _expected_plugin_build_sha, format_install_manager_report - matching the ticket's 'spans 6 functions'; after the rename the 'data' group is empty, the file mutation record count is unchanged (185) and no (file, variable) group reaches the >= 5 threshold (largest remaining group is 4 scopes for the pre-existing 'raw' locals).
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named data again and the smell report returns.

commands: python3 -c "<standalone code2llm DFGExtractor(Config()).extract(ast.parse(<file>)) + per-variable mutation-scope grouping, original vs renamed content of src/koru/autopilot/install_manager.py>"
validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth with the installed code2llm extractor on the file AST. Baseline content reports a 'data' mutation group of 6 scopes (_source_version, _is_koru_source_root, _installed_editable_source_root, _expected_plugin_version, _expected_plugin_build_sha, format_install_manager_report) - exactly matching the ticket's reported 'spans 6 functions'. Renamed content reports a 'data' group of 0 scopes; file mutation record count unchanged at 185 (pure rename); every renamed local lands at <= 2 scopes, far below the >= 5 threshold.

The module's dedicated suite (tests/test_install_manager.py) passes unchanged - pure rename of function-internal locals and one private helper parameter - and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree with the changed files declared.
